disposition: publish only after transition review and merge; no scientific stage is re-run

failure.review_verdict_on_001_and_002: TRANSITIONS SOUND; scientific inputs and the six named science modules byte-identical to the ready tag; every outcome_b_checks predicate a strict subset of its pre-transition acceptance set. These were recorded as non-blocking residual risks, not falsifications.
failure.root_cause: An adversarial review of transitions 001 and 002 found the sealed-transition files acted as an unauthenticated digest allowlist for candidate_frozen. _authorised_predecessor_source_digests() accepted any digest named by any transition document, with no check that the authorising transition described the source actually running, so a freeze could validate against source nobody transitioned to.
secondary: _bed_result_content_valid required only that the P1 and P3 effect rows be dicts. A row of the right shape carrying a string effect, a null effect, a malformed interval, or an inverted interval still reached the SESOI and interval comparisons downstream.

repair.authorisation_binding: a sealed transition authorises a predecessor digest only when its own transition_source_digest equals the live source digest, so the chain must terminate at the code actually running
repair.behavior: bind the authorisation chain to the running source, and require scored effect rows to carry real numbers
repair.effect_row_content: mean_paired_effect must be a real number (not bool), confidence_interval_95 must be a two-element list of real numbers, and the lower bound must not exceed the upper bound

residual_risks_accepted: the seven gates labelled field_asserted in gate_verification_method remain forgeable by anyone with write access under evidence/substrate/final_revision/
the continuity lane still trusts self-declared segment durations; nothing cross-checks a receipt against real elapsed time, process identity, or the checkpoint chain
clean_report['install'] can shadow an operator receipt when both are present
activation scanning does not parse JSON embedded in strings
